steps.what: Review active hydroelectric operating conditions and open maintenance or repair work
Decide operating and maintenance priorities and resolve conflicting constraints
Direct operators and maintenance staff and confirm understanding of responsibilities
Record and confirm the actual directions, constraints and responsibilities
Save the approved direction record in its current work record

tasks.design: Retain direct supervision through the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} plant and work-order views. Separate the manager's actual direction record from live discussion; a new view alone does not establish less review, judgement or staff coordination.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plant priorities depend on live conditions and people.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing operational systems already support status review and work records.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve competing operational and maintenance needs.
tasks.human_edge: Direct staff and confirm that responsibilities are understood.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: plant status displays and work orders support supervision but do not replace live direction.

assumptions: Boundary includes the manager's status review, decisions, live direction and recording those directions; performing repairs and broad record maintenance are separate tasks.

Existing operators and work-order owners provide actual status, asset/task ID and restrictions. s4 explicitly counts capture of directions, recipients, time and conditions from s3. Missing information requires direct enquiry; no free new capture or reduced physical work is assumed.
Native status views and structured instruction fields are considered first. No existing duplicate entry or avoidable navigation is established, so neither review nor note capture is reduced.
Same-record save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is retained and approval follows the completed record. Provisional B=100, R=100, gross=0; upkeep=0; net=0. Shares are independent of means priors.
unknowns: Whether a real duplicate instruction record exists
research_questions: Observe supervision and trace the actual instruction record before proposing automation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Live direction and its record are separately counted; no concrete mechanism reduces their labour from the existing native system.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Observe power-system alarms and current operating indications
Determine whether the observed situation is a power-system emergency
inputs: current plant context and established emergency procedures

steps.what: Prepare the factual emergency briefing for the identified contacts
Verify and approve the current briefing facts and contact recipients
outputs: approved emergency briefing v1 and contacts

steps.what: Communicate the identified emergency directly to the required contacts
inputs: approved emergency briefing v1 and contacts
outputs: emergency communicated and contact understanding confirmed

tasks.design: Configure a factual briefing view in {OPS_SYSTEM} from existing event tags and the emergency the manager identifies. The manager verifies current facts and recipients and personally communicates through {TELEPHONY}; the tool neither identifies emergencies autonomously nor sends alerts.
tasks.previous_blocker: A factual briefing may require transcribing current event details.
tasks.enabler_now: A native template can reuse current event identifiers and timestamps.
tasks.still_hard: Recognize an emergency and communicate its changing significance.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret context and establish shared understanding during the call.

ambition.what: Reduce factual briefing preparation without reducing live emergency judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: event facts can populate a briefing template while emergency identification and communication remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is identification and communication, not corrective control or a later incident investigation. Briefing preparation and the actual communication are separate steps.

Existing instruments supply event/tag ID, timestamp, state/value, unit and quality flag. s2 counts manager selection of the emergency description, context and contacts from an existing maintained procedure. Missing or stale data requires manual preparation; no new sensor/feed is assumed.

Native event briefing features come first. Central requires real current preparation/transcription and removes half of that effort only. Existing alarm runtime is excluded. Direct urgent communication remains available immediately and does not wait for an automated workflow.
Approval follows the final current briefing; changed facts or contacts require fresh verification. No communication duration reduction is claimed.
Provisional B=100, R=92.5, gross=7.5; focal upkeep=0.5; net=7, independent of means priors.
research_questions: Replay past events and time factual preparation separately from identification and calls.

already_counted.description: Verify current briefing facts and contacts

incremental.description: Check briefing-field mappings and contact-reference failures

approvals.approved_version: approved emergency briefing v1 and contacts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the current native view already supplies briefing facts. High: 7.5 hours of preparation reduction face three extra stale-fact checks and 0.5 upkeep hours, leaving four.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain hydroelectric operations and repair records

steps.what: Capture actual operating explanations and verified maintenance or repair details
inputs: verified staff reports of work performed

steps.what: Gather and reconcile the applicable telemetry, work orders and supporting records
inputs: existing telemetry and completed work records

steps.what: Assemble the maintained operations, maintenance and repair record entries
outputs: operations and repair record draft v1

steps.what: Review record accuracy, resolve corrections and approve the final maintained entries
inputs: operations and repair record draft v1
outputs: approved operations and repair entries v1

steps.what: Commit the approved maintained entries to the current record
inputs: approved operations and repair entries v1
outputs: maintained hydroelectric records v1 with source history

tasks.design: Configure source links in {OPS_SYSTEM} and deterministic entry assembly from actual notes and completed work records. The manager captures missing facts and reviews every final entry before the separate record commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Operational explanations and completed work references may require repeated collation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset and work-order links can populate record entries while preserving source history.
tasks.still_hard: Verify what work actually occurred when records disagree.

ambition.what: Maintain traceable records with less repeated collation.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4; operational records and applicable staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: asset-linked actual work records can support deterministic record assembly with human factual review.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining records, including missing-detail capture and corrections, not performing maintenance or routine instrument logging.

Existing instruments supply tag/time/value/unit/quality; work-order owners already record asset ID, actual action, time, parts and outcome. s1 counts manager capture of verified explanations and missing work details, with source and uncertainty. Planned work completion never substitutes for actual work.
Native record features come first. Central reduces 40% of human collation and 70% of entry assembly only; runtime of existing telemetry and all final review are excluded from savings.
Same-record commit is effectively zero; minimum 1 earns no saving. Final entries exist before approval, and edits invalidate it.
Provisional B=100, R=72.5, gross=27.5; focal upkeep=1.5; net=26. Shares are independent of means priors.
research_questions: Trace maintained entries to actual telemetry and completed work records and measure missing-detail capture.

incremental.description: Audit source mappings and record completeness

approvals.approved_version: approved operations and repair entries v1

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: existing record configuration already covers the work. High: 27.5 gross points require six extra missing-detail/correction hours and 1.5 upkeep hours, leaving 20.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform or direct environmental containment and cleanup

steps.what: Assess the actual environmental threat and determine containment or cleanup responsibilities
Perform containment or cleanup or direct staff performing the work
outputs: actual containment or cleanup work and observed outcome

steps.what: Record and confirm actual containment actions, outcome and unresolved environmental concerns
inputs: actual containment or cleanup work and observed outcome

steps.what: Save the approved environmental response note in its current incident record

tasks.design: Retain field response and direction with the manager and response staff at {OTHER}. Use the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} incident record for actual actions and outcomes; no automatic cleanup or unobserved completion is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Containment and cleanup depend on actual changing conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing incident forms support capture, but do not establish a shorter field response.
tasks.still_hard: Judge whether the response has protected the environment.
tasks.human_edge: Perform or direct work and verify outcomes on site.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: environmental response involves physical action and verification; incident forms retain actual outcomes.

assumptions: Boundary includes response assessment, the manager's actual performance or direction and its incident note. Other responders' unchanged labour is not claimed as removed focal work. External regulatory reporting, if required, is a separate task rather than hidden in field work.

s3 counts capture of actual location/time, observed issue, actions, people involved, outcome and unresolved concerns from s2. No planned action is treated as completed. Existing form defaults and templates are considered, but no duplicate transcription or shorter capture is established.

Same-record save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is fully retained and approval follows the completed note. Provisional B=100, R=100, gross=0; incremental=0; net=0. Shares are independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual response-note workflow and duplicate entry
research_questions: Observe containment work and trace its incident note before proposing record automation.

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Field response and its actual note capture are explicit; neither is reduced without a concrete change to existing work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Hydroelectric managers retain plant direction, emergency judgement and environmental response while existing records assist factual preparation.
reach: Maintenance staff: preserve actual work details
role.ambitious_version: A hydroelectric manager supported by traceable records who retains responsibility for people, plant conditions and environmental response.
